items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: but we were together before we went with Vernon Andrade

ctx.x: Well, when did he have a band?

Louie -- you know, Louie went with Duke for a while. And -- but we were together before we went with Vernon Andrade Louie had the group -- we went and went up to formed a group and (unintelligible) the Savoy. We had a national-group there. It was eight of us. And then we went down to the Village. And after that band disbanded, Louie Andrade had a small group. Then Vernon Andrade started picking men,

and Louie, picked him, and went with Vernon Andro For Andro (unin- telligible) about three years, because Louie was the one that set these little entertainment groups and different things to play, and Al Morgan was on bass, Zootie. Oh, we had a good group, a good outfit.
